calls.title: Craig Kendall and Chris Sanders
calls.summary: The team discussed the implementation of the GrowthBook SDK and the integration of data flows, emphasizing the need to verify completeness. Led by Craig Kendall and comprising 30 engineers, the team confirmed that the SDK uses user attributes for filtering and triggers callbacks to analytics tools like GA4 and Databricks. Key points included the necessity for specific data shapes in experiment assignments, the mapping of GA4 user IDs, and the legal constraints affecting the use of a Managed Warehouse. The meeting also highlighted the organization of experiments, the risks of using dev mode, and the ongoing support framework, including scheduled follow-ups with data scientists to finalize setup and ensure effective communication via Slack and Teams.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook SDK, experiment tracking, GA4 integration, data warehouse, Edge SDK, feature flags
